say.zh: 每样东西都喜欢某样东西，所以有一样东西喜欢自己。
say.en: Everything likes something, so something likes itself.

brief.zh: 这是别人照上面这段推理写的引理。造一个反例：前提都成立，结论不成立。
brief.en: Here is a lemma someone wrote for the reasoning above. Build a counterexample: every premise holds and the goal fails.

hint.zh: 两样东西，互相喜欢，都不喜欢自己。
hint.en: Two things that like each other and not themselves.

t.zh: <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref>把 x 换成一样东西。要是换进去的是变量 y，而 x 恰好在一个「∃y」里面，这个 y 就被那个量词抓走（<wiki-ref to="capture"></wiki-ref>），意思全变了：在「每样东西都喜欢某样东西」里把 x 换成 y，好像得到「有一样东西喜欢自己」。
t.en: <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref> puts a thing in for x. If what goes in is the variable y and x sits inside an “∃y”, that y is caught by the quantifier (<wiki-ref to="capture"></wiki-ref>), and the meaning changes completely: putting y in for x in “everything likes something” seems to give “something likes itself”.

after.zh: 所以代入前要先给量词的变量改名；证明器的<part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref>会自动这样做。
after.en: So the quantifier’s variable is renamed before substituting; the prover’s <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref> does this by itself.
